Leah (CS Ops): quick heads up  launching a small CRM cleanup this evening. export of ~120 candidate pairs is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/cleanup-export. targeting accounts with healthscore_drop > 0.2 and last_touch > 45d.
Marco (Data): thanks. confirm the export excludes accounts with renewal_date within 60 days? we need to avoid touching near-term renewals.
Leah (CS Ops): yes excluded renewals <= 60 days. sheet col H = renewal_window_days. i'm only running automated merges for low-risk ACV buckets (<25k) unless manually approved.
Ivy (CS Manager): add a pre-merge AE check: if ACV >= 25k OR renewal_probability >= 0.7 then escalate to AE ops for manual sign-off.
Jon (Onboarding): i'll flag any rows where onboarding_status != "complete" so we don't merge active onboardings.
merge-bot: Playbook deploy scheduled 20:00 UTC. Dry-run will run first and produce audit log.
Leah (CS Ops): playbook guardrails: 
- `match_score >= 0.9` required for auto-merge
- skip if `open_support_tickets > 0` or `onboarding_status != "complete"`
- do not auto-merge if ACV >= 25k or renewal_window_days <= 60 (escalate instead)
Marco (Data): patched the match scoring SQL to include name_token_overlap and domain_match. running a recalculation now.
Ivy (CS Manager): also require a healthscore delta check: only auto-merge if healthscore_drop < 0.5 in the last 14 days to avoid merging churned accounts.
Leah (CS Ops): noted. i've updated the playbook conditions accordingly and added `csops:cleanup-2026-03` audit tag to be applied on merges.
Jon (Onboarding): added a sheet column `onboard_note` for any accounts I need to keep. i'll review the 28 flagged as onboarding-related.
Leah (CS Ops): action items: 
- @Jon finish onboarding flags by 17:30 UTC
- @Marco post the recalculation results and attach the dry-run log
- @Ivy prepare the AE escalation template (one-line + link to row + quick approve/deny buttons)
I'll run dry-run at 19:50 UTC and post results.
Marco (Data): dry-run complete  18 proposed auto-merges, 4 escalations, 2 with open tickets. dry-run log: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbook/logs/3124567999
Leah (CS Ops): dry-run looks clean. holding live merges until onboarding flags and AE template are in place. planning live run at 20:15 UTC in batches of 15/minute.
Ivy (CS Manager): AE template ready and shared in the sheet. added a short feedback link for post-escalation notes.
Leah (CS Ops): starting first batch now. will post summary + merged IDs when done. thank you :rocket:
